Title: Private Hiroshima and Miyajima Tour with Local
Description:

A local Hiroshima-born guide including second generation of A-Bomb survivors will lead you through the spiritual beauty of Miyajima and the sad history and powerful reconstruction of the city at the Peace Memorial Park.


You will visit Miyajima, Itsukushima Shrine, Daishoin temple, A-Bomb Dome, the Peace Memorial Park and the Peace Memorial Museum.

On this special private tour, the itinerary is completely customizable to your interests, allowing you to make the most of your time in Hiroshima. We offer a unique combination of local and international perspectives on Japanese culture and daily life while exploring Hiroshima's must-see sites. From local hidden gems to local food, we tailor our tours to our guests' preferences to create memories that will last a lifetime.

Join us on a personalized tour to Hiroshima for a rich and immersive experience that blends history, culture, and beauty!

Title: Hiroshima: Tomonoura Nostalgic Port Town Private Tour with Local
Description:
Step back in time and explore Tomonoura, a designated Japan Heritage site that has preserved its historic charm since the days when it flourished as a bustling port during the Shogun era. Stroll along the serene harbor, where the breathtaking views of the Seto Inland Sea blend seamlessly with the town’s nostalgic atmosphere.


Take in the breathtaking panoramic views of the Seto Inland Sea from Taichoro, a historic guest hall overlooking the harbor. Capture stunning photos at the iconic Joyato Stone Lighthouse — the beloved symbol of Tomonoura.  Delve deeper into history with a visit to the Ota Family Residence, where you'll experience the elegant lifestyle of the Edo period, then stroll through the town's quiet streets, stopping by ancient temples and a traditional brewery crafting Homeishu — a famed medicinal rice wine. 


Join a local guide on an intimate walk through this picturesque port town — a place so enchanting it inspired Hayao Miyazaki’s beloved Studio Ghibli film "Ponyo".  This private tour can be tailored to your interests — including a behind-the-scenes look at the inspirations for Studio Ghibli's Ponyo, which drew from Tomonoura's magical scenery.  


Whether you're traveling with family or friends, this private tour offers a personalized experience. Create unforgettable memories in Tomonoura — a hidden coastal treasure waiting to be discovered.
